question: Prabhat Sarma, a recipient of Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, was a _______ player from Assam.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prabhat Sarma**, a folk exponent and flutist from Assam, was renowned for his mastery of Borgeet compositions attributed to Srimanta Sankardeva and Madhavdeva from the 15th-16th centuries.
 
• Sarma explored Sattriya dance, a classical form pioneered by Srimanta Sankardeva.
